definitions.explanation: A break or pause between activities; spare time during a busy schedule.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}の{合間|あいま}にコーヒーを{飲|の}む。
examples.english: I drink coffee between work tasks.

examples.japanese: {授業|じゅぎょう}の{合間|あいま}に{友達|ともだち}と{話|はな}した。
examples.english: I talked with friends between classes.

examples.japanese: {合間|あいま}を{見|み}つけて{勉強|べんきょう}する。
examples.english: I study whenever I find spare moments.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕事|しごと}の{合間|あいま}に: between work tasks
- {合間|あいま}を{見|み}つける: to find spare time
- {合間|あいま}を{縫|ぬ}って: squeezing in between (activities)
- ちょっとした{合間|あいま}に: during a brief interval

NUANCE:
{合間|あいま} emphasizes using small pockets of time productively or for brief activities.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {間|あいだ}: between, interval (more general)
- {休憩|きゅうけい}: break, rest
- {隙間|すきま}: gap, crack (physical)
